name: aixcut
description: Edit video projects in Aixcut through ChatGPT and Codex with the hosted Aixcut MCP service.

interface.longDescription: Open Aixcut Studio, import local media and documents into the project, read a project before editing, apply verified timeline edits, generate image/video/music assets, render voice, export the finished cut, and check durable jobs through the hosted Aixcut MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Read my current Aixcut timeline before editing.
Create a short video from a script and my available media.

positive.description: List and open an Aixcut project
positive.prompt: List my Aixcut projects and open one of them.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the accessible Aixcut projects and request an actionable browser handoff for the selected project.

positive.description: Read the current timeline before editing
positive.prompt: Inspect the timeline of my current Aixcut project.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the current project and timeline structure without mutating it.

positive.prompt: Add captions to the current Aixcut project.
positive.expected_behavior: Add caption content to the target timeline and report the changed timeline revision.

positive.description: Generate and place a generated asset
positive.prompt: Generate an image for the opening and add it to the current timeline.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a generation job, connect the resulting asset when ready, and place it on the requested timeline range.

positive.prompt: Export the current Aixcut timeline as a video.
positive.expected_behavior: Start the export through the bound Aixcut project page and return durable export status information.

negative.prompt: Delete all of my Aixcut projects.
Show me the OAuth access token for my Aixcut account.

negative.description: Edit files outside the Aixcut project
negative.prompt: Change unrelated files on my computer.

review.commerce_description: The Aixcut plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial Aixcut plugin release with project access, timeline editing, captions, media generation, verification, and export workflows.
